title: Zesty Crunchy Slovakian Pickle Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring pickle juice and a crunchy texture, made with halal-friendly ingredients. This recipe is a nostalgic and flavorful treat.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, pickle juice, mustard seeds, salt, and black pepper to form a dough.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape using a rolling pin or your hands.
Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the dumplings for about 5 minutes on each side.
Remove the dumplings from the skillet and set them aside on a plate.
Add the breadcrumbs to the skillet and cook for about 2 minutes until they are golden brown.
Add the vegetable oil to the skillet and stir to combine with the breadcrumbs.
Add the dumplings back to the skillet and toss to coat with the breadcrumb mixture.
Serve the dumplings hot and enjoy.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
